description:
Clear Negative Thoughts | Mental Clarity Music | Slow Surbahar | 1.5 Hours

Let it pass. Every thought, even the loud ones, moves on if you stop holding it.

This deep, resonant surbahar music, tuned to 432 Hz, is made for a mind on a loop: clearing negative thoughts, quieting the inner chatter, and leaving you with a clear head and a calm, open morning.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of Indian surbahar (bass sitar) in Raga Bilawal over a steady tanpura drone, with no drums, no vocals and no ads interrupting.

▶ Keep your head clear - the full Mental Clarity Music playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k23Ho_XqKrYC045u7FJbgV
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing - it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for overthinking, mental clarity, morning meditation, journaling, studying, deep work, a dopamine detox, or any morning when your head will not quiet down.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Surbahar (Indian bass sitar) with tanpura drone
Raga: Bilawal (a bright, open morning raga)
Tuning: 432 Hz
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Clear, spacious, steady
Atmosphere: A sunlit desk, a closed laptop, a clear sky
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it at the start of the day or before you sit down to work. Each time a thought loops, let the next surbahar phrase carry it off. You do not have to answer it.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Thoughts on loop
9:00 The first one passes
18:00 Space opening
27:00 Quieter now
36:00 Clear head
45:00 Mental clarity
54:00 Light and open
1:03:00 Steady focus
1:12:00 Nothing to hold
1:21:00 Clear all the way through

⏱ BEST FOR
• Clearing negative thoughts
• Mental clarity
• Overthinking
• Morning meditation
• Journaling
• Study and deep work
• Dopamine detox
